Patch 0.1.19 (full Windows client)

This is a full reinstall build. Download it from the website Download button (Mega). Do not rely on the old 0.1.17 / 0.1.18 Apply patches — those could freeze the main menu.

Menu freeze fixes:
- Menu volumetric clouds wait a short time after load so the first frames do not look like Not Responding.
- Cheaper menu cloud ray steps.
- Dead LAN listing URLs in PlayerPrefs no longer stall update checks.

Also includes recent play fixes: loot hotbar-first, chest Take/Put All, creature vs creature, death cam, inventory mouse, public host list, and related Online updates.
